news.title: OpenAI接近完成由阿联酋投资者领投、估值1.25万亿美元的融资轮
news.snippet: 此轮融资由阿联酋投资者主导，若完成将使OpenAI估值达到1.25万亿美元，进一步巩固其AI领军地位。
news.raw_snippet:
In this article

OpenAI is closing in on a funding round that could value the artificial intelligence giant at more than $1 trillion ahead of a potential initial public offering.

The San Francisco-based AI company is raising up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, according to people familiar with the deal, who asked not to be named because the details were confidential. That valuation does not include new capital raised. [...] Anthropic's expected IPO would provide another test of investor appetite for the sector. OpenAI has filed confidentially to go public. [...] Investors from the United Arab Emirates are leading the round alongside Coatue, according to people familiar with the deal.

OpenAI told investors Thursday that it aims to secure signatures by the end of next week. The final size of the round is still being determined, the people said.

The financing is being positioned as an "opportunistic" bridge ahead of a potential IPO, the people said. An OpenAI listing will likely come in 2027, CFO Sarah Friar has told employees.

news.title: 分析：AI市场动荡拖累其他IPO，Anthropic上市计划独树一帜

news.raw_snippet: The AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations. [...] Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said. [...] The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.

news.title: 2026年AI研究资助计划发布
news.snippet: AI被列为2026年最明确的资助重点，NSF官员表示相关拨款将重点支持前沿AI基础研究与应用探索。
news.raw_snippet: AI is the clearest funding priority of 2026. NSF officials have said openly that artificial intelligence now drives agency grantmaking, backed by the AI Institutes network and major new initiatives. The Department of Energy stood up a dedicated AI office, and philanthropic funders including Schmidt Sciences, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Sloan Foundation have all launched substantial AI research programs. While most fields are fighting over a shrinking pool, AI funding is growing on [...] Yes. Much of today's AI funding supports applying AI to other fields, such as biology, chemistry, materials science, medicine, agriculture, and the social sciences. Several programs explicitly prefer interdisciplinary teams that pair domain scientists with machine learning researchers, so a strong scientific question can matter as much as AI expertise. [...] The opportunity is much broader than core machine learning. A large share of new funding targets AI for science: applying modern models to problems in biology, chemistry, materials, medicine, agriculture, and the social sciences. There is also growing investment in trustworthy and safe AI, in AI infrastructure and benchmarks, and in training the research workforce. news.title: 纽约州长Hochul宣布成立AI Jobs Institute
news.snippet: 该机构旨在帮助纽约居民掌握未来AI相关岗位所需技能，促进本地人才培养与新兴产业就业机会增长。
news.raw_snippet: Pursuit CEO Nick Simmons said, “New York has an opportunity to set the national standard for how AI creates opportunity. The AI Jobs Institute will bring together public leadership, industry expertise, and trusted community-rooted training so that New Yorkers can build the skills and careers this new economy demands.” [...] Empire State Development President, CEO and Commissioner Hope Knight said, “Under Governor Hochul’s leadership, New York is investing in AI innovation and the workforce needed to translate that innovation into lasting economic opportunity. Our investment in the AI Jobs Institute will help connect New Yorkers with practical training aligned with employers’ needs, while helping businesses and entrepreneurs adopt new technologies.
